# TeachThought

> TeachThought provides research-informed teaching strategies, learning frameworks, and educational resources for K-12 educators grounded in cognitive science and pedagogy.

TeachThought is a comprehensive resource hub for educators seeking evidence-based instructional practices. The site combines theoretical frameworks (Bloom's Taxonomy, learning theories) with practical classroom strategies, assessment methods, and critical thinking approaches.

## Key Topics

- Bloom's Taxonomy
- Learning Theories
- Critical Thinking
- Project-Based Learning
- Assessment Strategies
- Instructional Design
- Cognitive Development
- Classroom Strategies
- Pedagogy
- Brain-Based Learning
- Inquiry-Based Learning
- Educational Frameworks
- Teaching Methods
- Adult Learning
- Neuroscience in Education

## Core Resources & Frameworks

- [TeachThought Homepage](https://www.teachthought.com): Research-informed teaching strategies and frameworks for K-12 educators.
- [Learning Theory](https://www.teachthought.com/learning/theories-definitions-and-examples): Overview of learning theories including Andragogy, Behaviorism, and Bloom's Taxonomy.
- [Teaching Dictionary](https://www.teachthought.com/teaching-dictionary): Comprehensive lexicon of key concepts for K-20 teaching and learning including AI terms.

## Instructional Strategies & Methods

- [Critical Thinking](https://www.teachthought.com/critical-thinking): Research-based critical thinking resources with Bloom's Taxonomy verbs and questioning techniques.
- [Project-Based Learning](https://www.teachthought.com/project-based-learning): Project-based learning definition, purpose, and implementation strategies using QFT.
- [Assessment](https://www.teachthought.com/assessment): Guide to formative and summative assessment strategies for gathering evidence of student understanding.

## Reference & Terminology

- [Neuroscience Terms](https://www.teachthought.com/teaching-dictionary/neuroscience-terms): Reference guide to neuroscience terminology and brain function implications for education.
